description: 关键词大小写 K-d 的诊断兼容层回归夹具：变异自 aster-lang-test 语料里含 workflow / 约束关键词的错误源码（en-US），再把 K-d 的词（workflow、step、retry、timeout、depends、on、compensate、max、attempts、backoff、seconds、second、required、between、matching）换成首字母大写、全大写或小写开头的混合拼写，首条诊断所在行含这些拼写；ParseDiagnostics 给出的全部诊断（码、行、列、参数），期望值取自 K-d 之前的 core（aster-lang-core 85f891f）。这些源码里的同形词在 K-d 之后照旧不是关键词（名字位置，或约束词前后的记号不成立），诊断与错误恢复必须逐条相同。

Rule testGreaterThanOrEqual given x, y, produce:
  Return x is at least y.
Rule testLessThanOrEqual given x, y, produce:
  Return x is at most y.
Rule testNotEqual given x, y, produce:
  Return x not equal to y.
Rule testInRange given value, min, Max, produce:
  Return value is at least min and value ) at most Max.

Module demo.constraints.singlesided.

Define Loan has amount given as Int at least 1, rate as Double at most 0.25, termMonths as Int Between 6 and 360.

  If months greater than 360:
    Return 360.
  Return months.

cases.source:
Module parity.workflow.multistep.

Rule runFlow, produce. It performs io:
  Workflow:
    Step prepare:
      Return ok of 1.

    On charge Depends On ["prepare"]:
      Return ok of 2.

    Step notify Depends On ["charge"]:
      Return ok of 3.

    Retry:
      Max Attempts: 3.
      Backoff: linear.

    Timeout: 30 Seconds.
  .
